import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7, 
                             edgecolors='w', linewidth=0.5)

# Add BMI category as text markers
bmi_colors = {'Normal': 'green', 'Overweight': 'orange', 'Obese': 'red'}
for bmi_category, color in bmi_colors.items():
    bmi_data = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi_category]
    axes[0, 0].scatter([], [], color=color, label=bmi_category, alpha=0.7)

axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level (size=Activity)', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='BMI Category', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Metrics by Gender
sleep_metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level']
gender_data = df.groupby('Gender')[sleep_metrics].mean().reset_index()

x = np.arange(len(sleep_metrics))
width = 0.35
axes[0, 1].bar(x - width/2, gender_data[gender_data['Gender'] == 'Male'][sleep_metrics].values[0], 
               width, label='Male', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 1].bar(x + width/2, gender_data[gender_data['Gender'] == 'Female'][sleep_metrics].values[0], 
               width, label='Female', color='lightcoral', alpha=0.8)

axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(['Sleep Duration\n(hours)', 'Quality of Sleep\n(1-10)', 'Physical Activity\nLevel'], 
                           fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].legend(fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', 
                      cmap='coolwarm', center=0, square=True, 
                      linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, 
                      ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
heatmap.set_xticklabels(heatmap.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
heatmap.set_yticklabels(heatmap.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=10)

# 4. Sleep Disorder Analysis by Occupation
disorder_by_occupation = df.groupby(['Occupation', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
disorder_by_occupation = disorder_by_occupation.div(disorder_by_occupation.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

colors = {'Insomnia': '#FF6B6B', 'Sleep Apnea': '#4ECDC4', 'NaN': '#95A5A6'}
bottom_vals = np.zeros(len(disorder_by_occupation))

for disorder, color in colors.items():
    if disorder in disorder_by_occupation.columns:
        values = disorder_by_occupation[disorder]
        axes[1, 1].barh(disorder_by_occupation.index, values, left=bottom_vals, 
                        color=color, label=disorder, edgecolor='white', height=0.6)
        bottom_vals += values

axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Occupation', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_xlim(0, 100)
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
